z06_exclusive_groups.notes: Wheel center cap choices are mutually exclusive within the Wheel Accessory section.
Indoor car cover choices are mutually exclusive within the LPO Exterior section.
Rear Corvette script badge color choices are mutually exclusive within the LPO Exterior section.
Suede frunk/trunk compartment liner choices are mutually exclusive within the LPO Interior section.
Ground effects choices are mutually exclusive; inactive members stay in the source for reactivation without appearing in draft output.
Exterior accent choices require either EFR or EDU; selected default cannot be cleared without choosing the alternate accent package.
Brake choices require one active brake selection; selected default cannot be cleared without choosing another brake package.

z06_exclusive_groups.display_label: Carbon Fiber Wheel and Aero Packages
z06_exclusive_groups.notes: PDB, PDD, and PDF are radio-like package peers; selecting one replaces the others without greying them out.
Z06 FA5 and FA6 carbon-fiber interior trim options are mutually exclusive.
Z06 aero choices are radio-like peers; T0E is the default and T0F/T0G/5ZV replace it without hard disabling peers.
Z06 exhaust tips are mutually exclusive; NGA is the default/restored tip and NWI replaces it when selected.
